optimizedDescription.value: Defines unified stateless language adapters for deterministic multi-language symbol, dependency, call, and hierarchy extraction.

optimizedContext.value:
# Language Adapter

## Rules

### Unified interface
- `LanguageAdapter` SHALL be stateless interface with:
  - `languages(): string[]`
  - `extensions(): Record<string, string>`
  - `analyzeFile(filePath: string, content: string, context: AdapterAnalyzeContext): FileAnalysisDraft`
  - `resolveImports(analysis: FileAnalysis, context: ImportResolutionContext): ResolvedImports`
  - `buildRelations(analysis: FileAnalysis, context: RelationBuildContext): readonly Relation[]`
  - optional `getPackageIdentity?(codeRoot: string, repoRoot?: string): string | undefined`
  - optional `resolvePackageFromSpecifier?(specifier: string, knownPackages: string[]): string | undefined`
  - optional `resolveQualifiedNameToPath?(qualifiedName: string, codeRoot: string, repoRoot?: string): string | undefined`
- Methods synchronous, deterministic, session-scoped; no outside side effects. Analysis receives content string. Compact run cache only through `IndexSession`.
- Single `analyzeFile` MUST emit complete `FileAnalysisDraft`: symbols, imports, deterministic binding/call facts, namespace data, optional compact parser state. No separate extractors; no AST/parser objects; plain serializable data.
- TypeScript/JavaScript, PHP, Python, Go MUST use unified `analyzeFile`/`resolveImports`/`buildRelations`; no legacy path.
- Code dependencies SHOULD emit concrete `IMPORTS`, `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE`, hierarchy relations; `DEPENDS_ON` reserved for specs.

### Detection and registry
- Extensions come from `extensions()`; unrecognized files silently skipped, no `FileNode`.
- `AdapterRegistry`: `register`, `getAdapter`, `getAdapterForFile`, `getLanguageForFile`, `getAdapters`; dynamic extension mapping, unique adapters.
- `TypeScriptLanguageAdapter` registered by default; handles `.ts`→`typescript`, `.tsx`→`tsx`, `.js`→`javascript`, `.jsx`→`jsx`.

### TypeScript adapter
- MUST use `@ast-grep/napi`.
- Symbols: named/arrow/HOF functions; classes; class/prototype/static/object/class-arrow methods; exported variables; member/namespace assignments; recursively unrolled destructuring; type aliases; interfaces; enums; CommonJS/UMD symbols.
- Immediately preceding JSDoc/block/contiguous line comment stored verbatim in `SymbolNode.comment`; otherwise `undefined`.
- Relations: `DEFINES`, `EXPORTS` including `module.exports`/`exports.*`, `IMPORTS`, `CALLS`.
- Callable member assignment yields qualified `method`; IIFE/object namespace target yields `variable`. Callable object properties/class fields yield `method`; call-expression initializer yields `function`; scalar object property yields `variable`.

### Imports and calls
- `ImportDeclaration`: `localName`, `originalName`, raw `specifier`, `isRelative`.
- Parse during `analyzeFile`; resolve in Pass 2:
  - TypeScript `import`: relative iff specifier starts `.`.
  - Python `from`/`import`: relative iff starts `.`.
  - Go imports and PHP `use`: never relative.
- Extract call facts during analysis; `buildRelations` resolves via local symbols, imports, receiver bindings, session facts.
- Caller = innermost function/method/arrow; drop top-level calls. Drop unresolved globals, ambiguous/dynamic callees without error.

### Scoped facts and dependency boundary
- Built-ins MUST emit deterministic scoped binding/call facts. Adapters own syntax; shared pipeline owns scope lookup, shadowing, receiver binding, cross-language filtering.
- Facts cover clear lexical scopes; typed parameters/properties/fields; construction; receivers (`this`, `self`, `cls`, `parent`, `super`); deterministic aliases; referenced/imported types; deterministic registry-based framework bindings.
- Persist relation only when target derives from source, imports, manifest package identity, qualified-name maps, or deterministic framework rules without executing code.
- Drop runtime/container identifiers, reflection, monkey patching, non-literal dynamics, ambiguous receivers, unresolved facts/imports, interprocedural alias flow. Diagnostics may retain non-persisted data.

### Built-in coverage
- TypeScript: static/side-effect/string-literal dynamic imports and `require()`; `new`; parameter/return/field/property types; constructor properties; `this`; deterministic member/namespace calls; `extends`/`implements`.
- Python: imports, string-literal `importlib.import_module()`/`__import__()`, deterministic package/`src/`/`__init__.py` layouts, constructors, annotations, `self`/`cls`, inheritance.
- Go: standard/grouped/aliased/dot/blank imports, resolvable file `IMPORTS`, deterministic selector calls, constructors/composite literals, non-speculative promoted methods/composition.
- PHP: require/include, dynamic loaders, loaded-instance calls, framework bindings; feed shared scoped model.

### Hierarchy
- Emit `EXTENDS` for resolvable inheritance, `IMPLEMENTS` for resolvable contract fulfillment, `OVERRIDES` for deterministic base/contract method match.
- MAY normalize semantically equivalent constructs; drop distortive or unresolved cases rather than add relation type.

### Package and import resolution
- `getPackageIdentity` searches from `codeRoot` upward, bounded by `repoRoot` or filesystem root: TypeScript `package.json.name`; Python `pyproject.toml [project].name`; Go `go.mod module`; PHP `composer.json.name`.
- CLI/MCP obtains `repoRoot` from `VcsAdapter.rootDir()`. Indexer builds `packageName → workspaceName`; adapters lacking method remain unresolved.
- Resolve imports through shared `IndexSession` indexes, not all-symbol scans or Pass 2 filesystem reads.
- `resolveImports` combines declarations, package identity, qualified-name lookup, deterministic adapter rules.
- Pass 2 qualified-name metadata (for example PSR-4) MUST be compact state prepared during analysis/session. PHP CakePHP, CodeIgniter, namespace resolution MUST use shared file/symbol lookups, avoiding O(N) scans.

### PHP dependencies and calls
- `require`, `require_once`, `include`, `include_once`: literal string path resolves relative to importer and emits `IMPORTS`; Pass 2 validates target. Drop concatenation, constants including `APPPATH`/`__DIR__`, variables.
- Deterministic literal/class loader targets emit file `IMPORTS`. Support CakePHP loaders/`App::uses`/`App::import`/`ClassRegistry::init`/`$uses`; CodeIgniter `$this->load->model|library|helper`; Yii `Yii::import|createObject`; Zend `Zend_Loader::loadClass`; additional deterministic resolver rules.
- Literal class-property dependencies are file signals. Generic `->get('x')` requires explicit resolver. Drop non-literal/container/unresolved targets; never fallback to file `DEPENDS_ON`.
- Within one function/method, track resolved loader/framework properties/simple aliases; class-property dependencies expose aliases to class methods; bare and receiver loaders share flow.
- Emit member `CALLS` only with resolvable caller+callee. Statically constructed/class-literal flow MAY qualify. No interprocedural propagation; drop ambiguous/runtime/unresolved calls.
- PHP loader support MUST be registry/module-based shared contract; adding API requires resolver definition, no core extraction change; unit-test each pattern.

### Internal parsing
- Tree-sitter/ast-grep queries are internal; never public interface.

## Constraints

- `LanguageAdapter` interface; stateless.
- `analyzeFile`, `resolveImports`, `buildRelations`, resolution methods synchronous/deterministic.
- `FileAnalysisDraft`, parser/cache state compact plain data.
- Only `getPackageIdentity` and `resolveQualifiedNameToPath` may perform I/O; Pass 2 MUST NOT probe filesystem per candidate.
- `resolveQualifiedNameToPath` SHOULD cache manifest/autoloader metadata per `codeRoot` or session.
- Indexer MUST contain no language-specific resolution.
- Unrecognized extensions and non-deterministic/unresolved calls, hierarchy, loaders, dynamic paths silently dropped.
- Loader APIs registry-extensible; parser queries internal.
- TypeScript adapter always default.
- No fuzzy/runtime inference.
- No dependency on `@specd/core`.
